Gru's Kitchen LabDespicable MeSteal the moon. Eat the bananas.Every recipe serves 4.

    RationsMinion banana bitesBanana coins dipped in honey yoghurt, rolled in peanuts or sprinkles, frozenHow to make it3 bananas200g Greek yoghurt1 tbsp honey60g roasted peanuts, crushed2 tbsp yellow sprinklesLine a tray with baking paper and slice the bananas into thick coins.Mix the yoghurt and honey.Dip each coin, then roll half in crushed peanuts and half in sprinkles.Freeze on the tray until firm.Serve straight from the freezer.Super Silly Fun Land corn dogsWin Agnes a fluffy unicorn. Cornmeal franks, fried goldenHow to make it150g cornmeal100g plain flour2 tbsp caster sugar2 tsp baking powder1 egg250ml buttermilk8 beef frankfurts8 wooden sticks1 L vegetable oil, for fryingmustard, to servetomato sauce, to serveWhisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, egg and buttermilk into a thick batter in a tall glass.Pat the beef frankfurts dry and push each onto a stick.Heat the oil to 180°C in a deep pot.Dip each frank in batter and fry a few at a time until golden.Drain and serve with mustard and tomato sauce.Hot messGru's meatballs in tomato sauceThe Moon, shrunk to meatball sizeHow to make it300g beef mince300g pork mince50g breadcrumbs, soaked in milk40g parmesan, grated, for the meatballs1 handful of parsley, chopped2 tbsp olive oil2 tins of crushed tomatoes3 cloves of garlic, crushed1 handful of basil leaves500g spaghetti40g parmesan, grated, for servingsalt and pepper, to tasteMix both minces with the soaked breadcrumbs, parmesan, parsley and seasoning.Roll into balls and brown in the oil in batches.Add the garlic, tomatoes and basil to the pan and simmer the meatballs gently.Cook the spaghetti in salted water while the sauce finishes.Toss the pasta with the sauce and serve with extra parmesan.Gru's lab crumbed chicken tendersVector stole the shrink ray, not these tendersHow to make itNot on tonight's cookChicken tenderloins in a crunchy parmesan and panko crumb, baked golden, with honey mustard, tomato sauce and a crisp potato wedge pile.Heat the oven to 220°C.Cut 1kg potatoes into wedges, toss with oil, paprika and salt, and roast for 35 minutes.Dip 800g chicken tenderloins in flour, then 2 beaten eggs, then 150g panko mixed with 40g grated parmesan.Lay on an oiled tray, spray with oil and bake for 15 to 18 minutes, turning once, until golden and cooked.Mix 3 tbsp Dijon with 3 tbsp honey and serve with tomato sauce.Sweet issueAgnes's so fluffy unicorn cakeThe girls' piggy bank funds the Moon heist. Vanilla layer cake, buttercreamHow to make it200g butter, softened, for the cake200g caster sugar4 eggs250g self-raising flour100ml milk250g butter, softened, for the icing450g icing sugar1 tsp vanilla extract1 tsp pastel food colouring1 piece of gold fondantHeat the oven to 175°C and line two cake tins.Beat the butter and sugar until pale, add the eggs one at a time, then fold in the flour and milk.Divide between the tins and bake until a skewer comes out clean.Cool the cakes completely.Beat the icing butter with the icing sugar and vanilla, split and colour in pastel shades.Sandwich and cover the cake, pipe a mane down one side and add a fondant horn.Door-to-door chewy coconut cookiesChewy coconut cookies. Cookie robots! I said cookie robots!How to make itNot on tonight's cookChewy coconut cookies with golden edges, half dipped in dark chocolate and packed into little boxes just like the girls sell.Heat the oven to 170°C.Beat 125g soft butter with 150g brown sugar until creamy, then beat in 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla.Mix in 150g plain flour, half a teaspoon of bicarb and 120g desiccated coconut.Roll into 20 balls, flatten slightly on lined trays and bake for 12 minutes until golden at the edges.Cool, then dip half of each in 150g melted dark chocolate and set on paper.CanteenMoon milk, warm honey vanilla milkFor the night Gru takes the Moon. Warm milk, honey, cinnamon and vanillaHow to make it1 L milk2 tbsp honey1 cinnamon stick1 tsp vanilla extractWarm the milk gently with the honey, cinnamon stick and vanilla until steaming, never boiling.Remove the cinnamon and pour into four mugs.Hot chocolate with mini marshmallowsGru reads Sleepy Kittens, then bed.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
